chunks: And in the narration of Abū Khadījah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

That Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, sent it down to Ādam عليه السلام from Paradise, and it was a white pearl. Then Allah, Exalted is He, raised it to the heaven, and its foundation remained, and it is in alignment with this House. Every day, seventy thousand angels enter it and never return to it again. Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, commanded Ibrāhīm and Ismāʿīl عليهما السلام to build the House upon the foundations.

key_terms.أُسُّهُ: Its foundation, which remained after it was raised.
key_terms.بِبُنْيَانِ ٱلْبَيْتِ: The building of the House, commanded to Ibrāhīm and Ismāʿīl.
key_terms.دُرَّةً بَيْضَاءَ: A white pearl, describing the original form of the House.
key_terms.سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ: Seventy thousand angels who enter it each day.
key_terms.هَذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ: This House, referring to the Kaʿbah.
key_terms.ٱلْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the place from which the House was sent down.
key_terms.ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ: The foundations upon which the House was built.

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the origin of the Kaʿbah and its heavenly connection?
ai.summary: This narration describes that the House was originally sent down to Ādam عليه السلام from Paradise in the form of a white pearl, then raised to the heaven while its foundation remained on earth. It also connects the earthly Kaʿbah to a heavenly reality entered daily by seventy thousand angels, and states that Ibrāhīm and Ismāʿīl عليهما السلام were commanded to build the House upon those foundations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2302 - In a narration from Abu Khadijah, from Abu Abdullah (as):

"Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, sent the House (Kaaba) down to Adam (as) from Paradise. It was a white pearl. Allah (swt) then raised it back to the heavens, leaving its foundation, which corresponds to this House (the Kaaba). Every day, seventy thousand angels enter it and never return to it again.
Then Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, commanded Ibrahim and Isma'il (as) to build the House upon its foundations."
